row.body: The vegetable crate has a delivery tag dated after the road was closed. A pencilled note asks whether the driver should still be charged for the trip.
row.title: The last crate

sidecar.gloss: A food delivery is recorded after access closed, with the driver’s payment unresolved.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field supply route could also have been delayed by access restrictions; the tag cannot explain who closed the road.
